mag.name: Magnets and sun sensors: rough aim
mag.desc: Uses Earth's magnetic field to turn. Coarse pointing (~5°).
mag.simplified: The levels and the percentages of the platform are our own simplification of three real attitude control families; pointing accuracy is the typical value of each.

rw.name: Spinning wheels: steady aim
rw.desc: Flywheels that spin to aim the craft. Fine pointing (~0.1°).
rw.simplified: The levels and the percentages of the platform are our own simplification of three real attitude control families; pointing accuracy is the typical value of each.

st.name: Wheels and a star camera: precise aim
st.desc: A camera recognizes constellations for precision pointing (~0.001°).
st.simplified: The levels and the percentages of the platform are our own simplification of three real attitude control families; pointing accuracy is the typical value of each.
